About.title: About me
About.badge: Software Engineering student with hands-on technology experience
About.p1: I'm a Software Engineering student and currently work in an administrative role where I also support IT systems, equipment and process improvements. Working close to real operational problems led me to build automations and applications for everyday tasks.
About.p2: My current focus is back-end development, APIs, Java and Spring Boot, while React, TypeScript and Python are part of my toolkit when the problem calls for a complete solution.
About.quote: I like to understand the problem first and use technology to make what used to be difficult simpler.

AboutModern.p1: My Software Engineering studies are backed by projects where I have worked on architecture, persistence, authentication, APIs, testing and user experience — not just screens.
AboutModern.p2: I also bring what I learn from administrative processes and IT support into software: observe the real workflow, find friction and automate what makes sense.
AboutModern.bullet1: Java, Spring Boot and REST APIs
AboutModern.philosophy_text: Understand the problem, build something maintainable and prove that it works.
